ABOUT US

Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands — including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank — to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

Our co-founders are Bret Taylor https://www.linkedin.com/in/brettaylor/ and Clay Bavor https://www.linkedin.com/in/claybavor/. Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps. Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace.


ABOUT THE CONSUMER BUSINESS SERVICES TEAM

 - Sierra partners with the businesses that power everyday life for consumers and enterprises alike — from the CPG brands on every shelf to the logistics networks that get products there, the real estate and facilities teams that manage the buildings people live and work in, and the energy and utility providers that keep the lights on. Our agents handle everything from order tracking and account management to field service scheduling and billing support, tuned to the voice and workflows of each business.

 - This vertical spans a wide range of industries — consumer products, commercial real estate, automotive & mobility, transportation & logistics, industrial manufacturing, information & data services, consumer electronics, professional services, facilities management, construction, energy, and utilities — giving you the breadth to build relationships across some of the largest and most established companies in the world.

 - Join us to bring AI agents to the businesses that quietly run the economy — and help build technology that makes these essential services faster, more reliable, and more human for everyone who depends on them.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Be the primary partner to your Sales counterparts helping to win deals and grow customers

 - Go from first discovery to a tailored, working agent in days, not weeks, across prospects and existing customers

 - Own the end-to-end technical pre-sales process by scoping customer use cases, articulating business value, designing and demoing Sierra’s incredible platform, leading technical and architecture reviews, and serving as the trusted technical expert throughout the sales cycle

 - Work directly with our Sales, Product and Agent Engineering teams to both drive our GTM function, as well as continuously improve our Agents through our customer-driven product development philosophy

 - Go deep on your industry, the patterns, and winning motions to scale your work


WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - 3-4+ years experience in Sales Engineering, Solutions Engineering or customer-facing technical sales

 - Experience in leading the sales process with Enterprise customers with deal sizes ranging $200-$500k

 - Past experience in demo building, and presenting, and working with customers or clients in the GTM function

 - Experience in relationship-building with prospects, including executives and technical leaders

 - Ability to connect a prospect’s specific business problems and Sierra’s solutions and explain them to both a technical and non-technical audience

 - Ability to leverage AI tools efficiently as a regular part of your technical sales motion — discovery prep, solution design, demo and prototype building, technical proposals. Importantly, you own the accuracy of anything you put in front of a customer, whether or not AI helped you build it

 - A track record of handling a high number of deals concurrently without cutting quality, and comfortable switching between sub-industries and use cases

 - Bachelor's Degree or above; bonus if in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent professional experience


EVEN BETTER...

 - Experience translating code, technical logic and user requirements to product and engineering requirements

 - Selling a technical AI product


OUR VALUES

 - Trust: We build trust with our customers with our accountability, empathy, quality, and responsiveness. We build trust in AI by making it more accessible, safe, and useful. We build trust with each other by showing up for each other professionally and personally, creating an environment that enables all of us to do our best work.

 - Customer Obsession: We deeply understand our customers’ business goals and relentlessly focus on driving outcomes, not just technical milestones. Everyone at the company knows and spends time with our customers. When our customer is having an issue, we drop everything and fix it.

 - Craftsmanship: We get the details right, from the words on the page to the system architecture. We have good taste. When we notice something isn’t right, we take the time to fix it. We are proud of the products we produce. We continuously self-reflect to continuously self-improve.

 - Intensity: We know we don’t have the luxury of patience. We play to win. We care about our product being the best, and when it isn’t, we fix it. When we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time.

 - Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We are the best technology company for parents. We support and respect each other and celebrate each other’s personal and professional achievements.


WHAT WE OFFER

We want our benefits to reflect our values and offer the following to full-time employees:

 - Flexible (unlimited) paid time off

 - Medical, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family

 - Life insurance and disability benefits

 - Retirement plan dependent on country of employment

 - Parental leave

 - Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot

 - Lunch, as well as delicious snacks and coffee to keep you energized 

 - Discretionary benefit stipend giving people the ability to spend where it matters most

 - Free alphorn lessons

These benefits are further detailed in Sierra's policies, may vary by region, and are subject to change at any time, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation or benefits plans. Eligible full-time employees can participate in Sierra's equity plans subject to the terms of the applicable plans and policies.


BE YOU, WITH US

We're working to bring the transformative power of AI to every organization in the world. To do so, it is important to us that the diversity of our employees represents the diversity of our customers. We believe that our work and culture are better when we encourage, support, and respect different skills and experiences represented within our team. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. We strive to evaluate all applicants consistently without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, citizenship, or any other legally protected class.

What's the Job? 
 Great sourcing is about more than getting the right price. It’s about building the right supplier partnerships, understanding the market, and finding smarter ways to create value across the business. 
 We’re looking for a Strategic Sourcing Manager to help do exactly that.
 What You’ll Be Doing 
 Working across an approximately $500M annual procurement portfolio, you’ll develop and execute category strategies that strengthen supplier performance, improve efficiency and uncover opportunities for savings and added value. You’ll work across Food and Non-Food categories, partnering with suppliers and teams across the business to turn sourcing strategy into measurable results.
 Details 
 As our Strategic Sourcing Manager , you’ll play a key role and be at the forefront of building partnerships that deliver value, quality, and performance - with a focus on food (protein, produce, grocery) and non-food (autonomous robots, janitorial, chemical) categories.
 Build category strategies that align with Dexterra’s business priorities and evolving operational needs.
 Lead sourcing initiatives from RFP development and bid analysis through supplier evaluation and selection.
 Find opportunities to create value through cost savings, supplier rationalization, specification optimization and continuous improvement.
 Stay ahead of the market by analyzing industry trends, market conditions and pricing dynamics.
 Develop and negotiate supplier agreements , including pricing, service scope and contract terms, and manage performance throughout the contract lifecycle.
 Strengthen supplier performance through segmentation, performance management and strategic relationship building.
 Partner across the business to identify synergies, leverage scale and drive procurement efficiencies nationally and internationally.
 Use data to drive decisions , monitoring spend, supplier performance and compliance and translating insights into action.
 Manage supplier risk , identifying potential vulnerabilities and supporting mitigation strategies for critical services and asset-based categories.
 Improve how we work by strengthening supply chain processes, category programs and sourcing effectiveness.
 Support strong procurement governance and compliance with company policies, regulatory requirements and procurement standards.
Who are we looking for? 
 You’re a sourcing professional who can see the bigger picture while still getting into the details. You’re comfortable working with suppliers, negotiating agreements and using market and spend data to make sound business decisions.
 A post-secondary degree or diploma in Supply Chain , Business or Commerce, or equivalent experience.
 5+ years of related experience, ideally in strategic sourcing, procurement or category management.
 Experience with category-based buying and a strong understanding of supplier capabilities.
 Strong negotiation, financial and presentation skills.
 Strong analytical capabilities and advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office.
 The ability to build productive relationships with suppliers and internal stakeholders and work effectively across business units.
 Strong organizational, time-management and decision-making skills.
 An understanding of logistics and broadline distribution is an asset.
 Experience with Food and Non-Food/Food Service Products is an asset.
 Why Dexterra Supply Chain? 
 This is an opportunity to influence how Dexterra sources products and services across a diverse business, working with stakeholders across Canada and the US. You’ll have the opportunity to help shape category strategy, strengthen supplier partnerships and find smarter ways to deliver value across the organization.
WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU? 
 Be part of an industry that's more important than ever!
 Award winning safety culture.
 A flexible hybrid work model.
 Supportive team environment with room to grow together.
 Employee Referral Program.
 We are growing !
 Certified as a Great Place to Work 2025-2026 !
 Dexterra Group is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We are pleased to consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veterans’ status, Indigenous status, or any other legally protected factors. Accommodation is available upon request at all stages of the selection process.
 We thank all applicants for their interest and will contact those candidates selected for interview.

ARE YOU A BUILDER?

Then Jobber might be the place for you! We're looking for a Senior Front-End Developer to join our Web Strategy team.

Jobber exists to help people in small businesses be successful. We work with small home service businesses, like your local plumbers, painters, and landscapers, to transform the way service is delivered through technology. With Jobber they can quote, schedule, invoice, and collect payments from their customers while providing an easy and professional customer experience. Running a small business today isn’t like it used to be—the way we consume and deliver service is changing rapidly, technology is evolving, and customers expect more. That’s why we put the power and flexibility in their hands to run their businesses how, where, and when they want!

Our culture of transparency, inclusivity, collaboration, and innovation has been recognized by Great Place to Work, Canada’s Most Admired Corporate Cultures, and more. Jobber has also been named on the Globe and Mail’s Canada’s Top Growing Companies list, and Deloitte Canada’s Technology Fast 50™, Enterprise Fast 15, and Technology Fast 500™ lists. With an Executive team that has over thirty years of industry experience of leading the way, we’ve come a long way from our first customer in 2011—but we’ve just scratched the surface of what we want to accomplish for our customers https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EkfZmHrRLx4&list=PLoktA_D-2UEnxMLfCe93bANKXVXd2bdN8&index=24.




THE ROLE:

Jobber's website is one of our most important growth engines — the place where small home-service businesses first meet the product and decide to start a trial. The Web team builds and continuously improves getjobber.com http://getjobber.com, shipping new pages, running a high-velocity experimentation program, and pushing the limits of what a marketing site can do for conversion, SEO, and AI-driven discovery.

We're looking for a Senior Front-End Developer - ideally with full-stack experience/knowledge - to contribute to building our modern stack Jamstack projects and help raise the technical bar of the team. You'll work primarily in Next.js http://next.js/, Sanity, React and TypeScript within a headless/composable architecture, contributing to our growing UI library and the systems that lets us ship and test quickly. Back-end familiarity is important: our site is content-driven, so you'll work across a headless CMS with the APIs and services that power our pages. You'll regularly interface with engineers on the Product side. This is a senior individual-contributor role with real technical influence: you'll set patterns, mentor other developers, and partner with the Engineering Manager on standards and code quality — without carrying people-management responsibilities.

Just as importantly, we want someone who treats AI-assisted development as a core engineering skill. We're actively reshaping how we build — using AI coding agents, MCP-connected tooling, and automated workflows to move faster without sacrificing quality — and we want this person to help lead that evolution, not just keep up with it.

 

What you'll do:

Build on a modern front-end stack

 - Ship production features in Next.js http://next.js/, Sanity, and React with TypeScript across getjobber.com http://getjobber.com, from marketing and feature pages to conversion-critical surfaces like pricing.

 - Contribute to and extend our shared component library and design system so the team builds faster on consistent, reusable, well-tested foundations.

 - Own performance and accessibility as first-class requirements — Core Web Vitals, semantic and accessible markup, and fast, resilient page loads that directly support conversion.

 - Work across the stack on a content-driven site — integrate with a headless CMS, and build and consume the APIs and services that power our pages.

 - Write well-tested, scalable, well-organized code and drive consistent engineering practices through code review.

 - Collaborate with our other developers on best technical practices and project decisions.

Push our AI-assisted workflow forward

 - Use AI coding tools and agents fluently (e.g. Claude, AI-assisted IDEs, agentic workflows) to accelerate development while keeping a critical eye on output quality and reliability.

 - Improve how the team works with AI — building and refining MCP integrations, prompts, and context so our tickets, content, and codebase are AI-ready.

 - Help define and benchmark team standards for AI-assisted development — identifying what works, documenting it, and raising the whole team's baseline.

Power experimentation and growth

 - Build and ship A/B and multivariate experiments quickly, partnering with CRO and product stakeholders to keep the test pipeline moving.

 - Engineer for velocity — reduce the friction between a test idea and a live experiment, and make iteration cheap.

 - Support SEO, LLM, and AI-search initiatives with the technical foundations (structured data, performance, rendering) that keep the site discoverable as search evolves.

Raise the technical bar

 - Set patterns and technical direction for how we build, and bring the team along through pragmatic, well-reasoned decisions.

 - Mentor and coach other front-end developers, lifting their skills and holding the team to its engineering principles.

 - Partner with the Engineering Manager on technical standards, code quality, and architecture

 - Interface with engineers on the Product team, coordinating across shared systems and boundaries (e.g. the signup and pricing surfaces) to align on patterns, integrations, and handoffs.

 - Identify and act on opportunities to improve the stack, tooling, and processes, and maintain strong team documentation.

To be successful, you should have:

 - Deep front-end expertise. Expert command of HTML, CSS, JavaScript/TypeScript, accessibility, and web performance, plus several years building production applications.

 - Strong Next.js and React experience. You've built and maintained real applications on this stack and understand modern rendering, component architecture, and tooling.

 - Back-end familiarity — full-stack ideal. You're comfortable working beyond the front end: building and integrating APIs and services, and reasoning about the systems behind the pages. A full-stack background is highly preferred.

 - Headless CMS experience (required). You've built content-driven sites on a headless CMS and understand how to model, integrate, and ship content at scale.

 - Hands-on AI-assisted development. You actively use AI coding tools in your day-to-day work and have a point of view on where they help, where they don't, and how to use them responsibly.

 - A growth and experimentation mindset. You're comfortable building for measurement and iteration, and you care about the business outcome your code drives.

 - Technical leadership without ego. You set standards and mentor others while staying collaborative and open to better ideas.

 - Strong communication. You collaborate easily with both technical and non-technical partners — designers, marketers, PMs, and CRO.

 - Ambitious and humble. You don't accept the status quo simply because "it's what we've always done" — you push for better, newer, more innovative approaches while staying grounded.

 - Comfort in the grey areas. You're adaptable, can prioritize amid ambiguity and changing priorities, and break large, complex problems into shippable pieces.

Nice to have

 - Experience with client-side and feature-flag experimentation platforms (e.g. Optimizely, Kameleoon, Adobe Target) and analytics tools (e.g. Amplitude, GA360).

 - Experience working within a design system or maintaining a shared component library.

 - Experience collaborating with product engineering teams across shared systems.

 - Experience collaborating closely with designers in Figma.


LOCATION:

We believe great collaboration is intentional, and sometimes that means coming together in person to build, brainstorm, and connect. To support this, the role is open to candidates based in one of our hub cities: Edmonton, Toronto, Vancouver, or Kitchener-Waterloo.




COMPENSATION:

At Jobber, we believe that compensation should be transparent, fair, and reflective of your experience and growth. This role has a minimum annual salary of 125,715 a midpoint of $147,900, and a maximum salary of $170,085 designed to show the progression from learning the ropes to truly excelling.

We design our compensation to reflect each new hire’s skills, experience against the complexity of the role, ensuring a fair and competitive salary. Our range is intentionally broad to support growth and long-term impact, with fully established hires typically starting around the midpoint. The higher end of the range is reserved for those who have demonstrated deep expertise and lasting contributions, while offers below the midpoint reflect strong potential with room to develop.  You report to our Influencers & Partnerships Manager and have a designer for bigger creative pieces, but the thinking is yours and you're strong on graphics and short-form video yourself.  Own organic social for KittySpout and DoggySpout end to end across all social media channels. Success is accounts that keep growing and reach people who have never heard of us, with content created and published every day that grows an active, engaged community.
 Who are we?
 KittySpout is a premium DTC brand selling stainless steel cat water fountains, filters and accessories.  Better Everyday – test a new format, hook or post style every week, keep what works and improve the calendar and reporting along the way.
 Speed Is King – get a trend live the day it's spotted, publish on time every day and answer the community within 24 hours.
 Work Smart – use AI and tools so your time goes to strategy and creating: batch and schedule posts ahead, let Claude draft hook and caption variations, and automate the Monday report.
 Overdeliver – bring new content ideas to the Influencers & Partnerships Manager before being asked, and tell the team fast when something flops and what you're changing.
 If you want a stress-free corporate 9–5 job, this isn't it.

 90-day targets for each outcome are agreed with you before your start date. 
 Grow the audience on both brands – follower growth by brand and platform (Instagram, TikTok and Facebook insights)
 Reach people who have never heard of us – reach and non-follower reach per post by brand (platform insights)
 Content people save and share – saves, shares and engagement rate by brand (platform insights)

 Plan the content calendar one week ahead per brand and platform, mixing content for the existing community with content built to reach new audiences.
 Create and publish every day: write the hooks and captions, shoot and edit short-form video, and design day-to-day graphics and stories.
 Spot trends daily and get trend content live the same day.
 Turn the creator and UGC content from our creator programs into organic posts that perform.
 Run the community: comments, DMs, our Facebook group and tagged mentions.
 Read the data every week and act on it: double down on what works and drop what doesn't.
 Fully remote, full-time
 Native-level written English
 Hands-on Organic Social: 2+ years personally running organic social for a DTC or consumer brand – creating and publishing the content yourself, not just approving it or managing an agency.
 Proof: Accounts you grew and numbers you moved. We will ask for this.

 You won’t be micromanaged. We’ll give you a clear set of KPIs, meaningful ownership, and crystal clear expectations.  We don’t have mattresses at the office. Seriously Elon, what’s up with that?!?  This job might be for you if you’ve got… 
 5+ years of QA development experience, with real examples of automated testing strategies you’ve built, maintained, improved, or scaled.
 2+ years of leadership, mentorship, or coaching experience. You don’t need a giant ego or a fancy title. But you do need to know how to guide other QA developers, review their work, support their growth, and raise the technical standard of the team.

 The know-how to architect, optimize, and scale automated testing frameworks across frontend storefronts and backend middleware. Around here, that means working across our Shopify Hydrogen storefront and middleware
 Experience integrating automated tests into cloud-based CI/CD pipelines. You understand that automation is only useful if it gives developers fast, reliable feedback, and doesn’t randomly blow up the build because someone sneezed near the test runner.
 A sharp eye for quality metrics. We’re talking automation coverage, pipeline stability, test execution runtimes, flaky test reduction, production defect leakage, and the kind of reporting that helps the whole team make better decisions.
 Comfort with specialized QA spaces like API contract testing, performance profiling, load testing, and browser developer tool profiling. You don’t have to know everything.  Next level bug prevention skills. In fact, you’re so good at dealing with bugs you should probably be deployed on a mission to Klendathu.

 At xMentium, we help enterprises turn their unstructured language and documents into structured, usable data at scale. Our AI-powered platform, anchored by xTract, transforms sprawling repositories of contracts, licenses, technical documentation, communications, and other business-critical documents into clean, queryable metadata that powers analytics, agents, and downstream systems.
 We work across industries, including media and entertainment, oil and gas, manufacturing, real estate, financial services, and enterprise AI transformation more broadly, helping customers ground their AI agents, accelerate due diligence, unlock the value trapped in legacy repositories, and finally make their documents work for them.
 We understand that life is about more than just work and believe that driving to a headquarters is part of the problem. That's why we're a remote-first company and offer flexible work arrangements that empower you to balance your professional and personal life effectively. Your well-being is important to us, and we encourage a healthy work-life balance to ensure you have time for what matters most to you and can always do what you need to do.
 ABOUT THE ROLE 
 We're looking for a Senior Full Stack Developer to build and maintain production systems for our Document Intelligence platform. 
 Our extraction engine leverages a wide set of tools such as OCR, LLMs, and purpose-built ML models to extract data from complex documents at scale: legal documents, poor-quality scans, embedded diagrams, tabular images, and dense technical documents to name a few. In addition to automation of data extraction at scale, we emphasize quality with a specialized human-in-the-loop interface, ensuring accuracy of extractions before delivering data downstream. You'll work across our extraction pipeline, web application, and integration layers to produce high quality code and build features at enterprise scale.
 The ability to leverage AI tools for rapid development while maintaining a high degree of code quality is crucial to this role. We need someone who can reason through pull requests and talk about why code works, offer technical trade-offs, and suggest improvements. You'll use your technical acumen to judge the output of an LLM to be production-worthy or a confident hallucination. You can discern when something doesn't look right, and collaborate with the team when necessary to ensure high quality as we scale. You don't hand off to QA until you'd sign your name to it.
